all_minilm_l6_v2.usage: H-B kill-switch candidate: second, independently-pretrained small embedder for a potential additive 4th ensemble head (see docs/agent_handoff.md). Killed by the correlation kill-switch, not adopted - see experiments/improvements/v09_hb_killswitch.md for the result.

distilbert_base_uncased.usage: H-B kill-switch candidate: mean-pooled raw DistilBERT (MLM+distillation objective only, no contrastive similarity fine-tuning), chosen to isolate training-objective diversity from architecture diversity after all-MiniLM-L6-v2's kill-switch failed. See experiments/improvements/v09_hb_killswitch.md.

nli_mpnet_base_v2.usage: H-B kill-switch candidate #3: pure-NLI fine-tuned encoder (entailment/contradiction/neutral, no retrieval-contrastive training), a third point in the training-objective space vs all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (retrieval-contrastive, too correlated) and distilbert-base-uncased (no fine-tuning, decorrelated but weak). Note: config.json's _name_or_path leaks a relative local path (old_models/nli-mpnet-base-v2/0_Transformer) - not yet sanitized since this is a pre-adoption kill-switch check; sanitize before any packaging if this candidate is ever adopted. See experiments/improvements/v09_hb_killswitch.md.
